title: Thank You For Requesting The Adulting Like A Champ Assessment & Workbook
content:
Thank You [thrv_dynamic_data_request var_name='tve_name' default='so much' id='get' inline='1']! Please Check Your Email

Thank you for requesting Adulting Like A Champ! Please head to your inbox and confirm your email address to ensure a smooth delivery.

One-Time Offer!

Check Our Our Full SMART Goals Course & Receive 30% Off with Our Coupon Code: ADULTING

And learn the EXACT steps needed to help your learner achieve their goals... even if goal-setting has been a major struggle for them in the past!

Almost Done

Before you can receive the Adulting Like A Champ Assessment & Workbook, you need to confirm your email.

(It's easy)

Just go to your inbox, open the email from Life Skills Advocate, and click the link.

After that, you'll automatically receive a second email that contains the Adulting Like A Champ Assessment & Workbook.

And that's it!

PS: If you don’t see a confirmation email, please check your spam/junk folder. Sometimes the confirmation message ends up there by mistake.

If you run into any issues, please reach out to me at Chris@LifeSkillsAdvocate.com and I'll personally make sure you receive your item!
